dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I wanted to talk to you about next year. I'm going to raise the rent by 1,000 baht a month.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈtɔːk tə juː əˈbaʊt ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr. aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈreɪz ðə ˈrɛnt baɪ ˈwʌn ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt ə ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A thousand baht? That's a big increase. Can we negotiate?
dialogue.reading: ə ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt? ðæts ə ˈbɪɡ ɪnˈkriːs. kən wiː nɪˈɡoʊʃieɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm always open to negotiation.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. aɪm ˈɔːlweɪz ˈoʊpən tə nɪˌɡoʊʃiˈeɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, I'd accept a smaller increase, provided that you fix the air conditioner in my bedroom.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, aɪd əkˈsɛpt ə ˈsmɔːlər ɪnˈkriːs, prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt juː ˈfɪks ði ˈɛr kənˈdɪʃənər ɪn maɪ ˈbɛdruːm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's fair. It needs fixing anyway.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈfɛr. ɪt ˈniːdz ˈfɪksɪŋ ˈɛniweɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And I'd like the kitchen painted, too.
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪd ˈlaɪk ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈpeɪntɪd, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK, I'll paint it, on condition that you sign a two-year contract.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, aɪl ˈpeɪnt ɪt, ɑːn kənˈdɪʃən ðæt juː ˈsaɪn ə ˈtuː ˈjɪr ˈkɑːntrækt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Two years is fine, provided that the rent stays the same for both years.
dialogue.reading: ˈtuː ˈjɪrz ɪz ˈfaɪn, prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt ðə ˈrɛnt ˈsteɪz ðə ˈseɪm fər ˈboʊθ ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I think we can agree on that. So, how big an increase would you accept?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk wiː kən əˈɡriː ɑːn ˈðæt. soʊ, ˈhaʊ ˈbɪɡ ən ɪnˈkriːs wʊd juː əkˈsɛpt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can we talk about the amount next week? I need to check my budget first.
dialogue.reading: kən wiː ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ði əˈmaʊnt ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk? aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈtʃɛk maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪt ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sure. I'll write down everything we've agreed on so far.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. aɪl ˈraɪt ˈdaʊn ˈɛvriθɪŋ wiːv əˈɡriːd ɑːn ˈsoʊ ˈfɑːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. When we've agreed on the price, we can sign the agreement.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. wɛn wiːv əˈɡriːd ɑːn ðə ˈpraɪs, wiː kən ˈsaɪn ði əˈɡriːmənt.
